related.title: 霍恩西離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「被放棄的第二期」與「單月容量因數的紀錄」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩西離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "The phase that was given up" and "A record monthly capacity factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦泰晤士河口的 630 MW 風場：環境限制、單月容量因數紀錄與沙洲上的沖刷；霍恩西離岸風電場則以遠離岸 120 公里的交流併網：中途無功補償、2019 年大停電的教訓與遠海運維為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 630 MW farm in the Thames Estuary: environmental limits, a record monthly capacity factor and scour on sandbanks; Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm centres on AC connection 120 km from shore: mid-route reactive compensation, lessons of the 2019 blackout and far-offshore maintenance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「風功率與功率係數」的模型移到霍恩西離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「中途無功補償站」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Wind power and power coefficient" to Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The mid-route reactive compensation station", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「被放棄的第二期」與「單月容量因數的紀錄」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩西離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "The phase that was given up" and "A record monthly capacity factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.

related.title: 沃爾尼擴建離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「被放棄的第二期」與「單月容量因數的紀錄」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；沃爾尼擴建離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "The phase that was given up" and "A record monthly capacity factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Walney Extension Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦泰晤士河口的 630 MW 風場：環境限制、單月容量因數紀錄與沙洲上的沖刷；沃爾尼擴建離岸風電場則以愛爾蘭海上的 659 MW 風場：兩種風機並用、灌漿接頭與登塔可及性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 630 MW farm in the Thames Estuary: environmental limits, a record monthly capacity factor and scour on sandbanks; Walney Extension Offshore Wind Farm centres on A 659 MW farm in the Irish Sea: two turbine types together, grouted connections and access for boarding, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「風功率與功率係數」的模型移到沃爾尼擴建離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「尾流虧損與機組間距」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Wind power and power coefficient" to Walney Extension Offshore Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wake deficit and turbine spacing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「被放棄的第二期」與「單月容量因數的紀錄」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；沃爾尼擴建離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "The phase that was given up" and "A record monthly capacity factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Walney Extension Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 倫敦陣列離岸風電場
history.text: 2001 年開始規劃；2011 年離岸施工開始；2013 年全面商轉並正式啟用；2014 年第二期取消。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2001: Planning began. 2011: Offshore construction began. 2013: Fully commissioned and inaugurated. 2014: The second phase was cancelled. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
